0022600109.text: The Mavericks host the Spurs in Dallas for their third game of the 2026-27 season, with Dallas at 1-1 and riding a one-game win streak while sitting 9th in the West, and San Antonio at 0-2 on a two-game losing streak and 12th in the West. Dallas is without Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Cooper Flagg (shoulder sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Kyrie Irving (knee), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), while San Antonio is missing Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain). The teams have not met yet this season, and in 2025-26 the Mavericks lost 0-4 to San Antonio, most recently 139-120 in San Antonio on April 10, 2026.
